title: Orphan Games: NES console in the FPGA
summary: A Nintendo Entertainment System rebuilt in the FPGA (fpganes by Ludvig Strigeus, GPL-2): CPU, picture chip, sound and every cartridge mapper fpganes has (MMC1, MMC2, MMC3, MMC5, AxROM, Color Dreams, Camerica, NINA, Sunsoft and more) in hardware. Play free homebrew games from the browser (keyboard or a USB gamepad) or on an ORPHAN Remote (CYD) screen. Real NES controllers plug into the hashboard connectors (J1 and J2, or any J with ORPHAN_NES_PADS) through a small 3.3 V adapter (not tested with a NES controller, yet). Disconnect every hashboard first. Carts up to 1 MB program + 1 MB graphics: the cart sits in the board's DDR memory and the FPGA reads it through an HP port, with a 32 KB + 16 KB cache in block RAM. by JMSCNC, makers of RotatoCAM.

slots.1: NES console (cart in the DDR via HP2 + caches, frame buffer, sound, pads, real NES pads on J1..J9)
